summary: This pass finds a very narrow US-listed universe for the frozen potato and French fry supply node. Lamb Weston is the clearest direct public asset owner/product leader, while most major competitors such as McCain, Simplot, Cavendish, and Agristo appear private or non-US-listed from the gathered evidence. JBT Marel is an underfollowed second-order equipment and automation supplier to food processors, not a potato pure-play. McDonald's and Yum Brands are included only as reference customer anchors because QSR fry consistency and supply reliability drive the switching-cost hypothesis. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
